Class EndGameState

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ControllerState
org.adsl.server.controller.states.EndGameState
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
public class EndGameState extends ControllerState
Automatic state that resolves end-of-game scoring and persists results.

On entry it applies all end-game building effects, tallies builder PP, inventor icon bonuses, and artist pairs for each player, then saves the match to the database and broadcasts the leaderboard to all clients. Returns null to signal that the game is over and the controller should be discarded.
